[[The Thundermaw]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Thraexis Thundermaw]], a [[boss]] in the [[Grothmar Wardowns]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Lightning damage]] 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Air Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of [[Air Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Enchantment|Enchantments]] last 20% longer

==Skin==
This uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Insectoid Staff]].
